items.title: Six reasons Democrats may fall short of a midterm landslide
items.blurb: A shrinking number of competitive races, uncertain Senate contests, turnout challenges and a Republican fundraising edge could limit Democratic gains despite widespread voter dissatisfaction with Donald Trump.

items.title: Protect Nepalis in Saudi Arabia
items.blurb: Houthi drones have killed a Nepali worker. Diplomacy must protect the rest and bring the stranded home.

items.title: Bhotekoshi floods leave older survivors grappling with loss, uncertainty and trauma
items.blurb: Two months on, many elderly survivors remain displaced, haunted by memories of the disaster and waiting for news of missing family members. Authorities are yet to establish how many older people were affected.

items.title: Where are Chitwan Rhinos heading this season?
items.blurb: After a third-place finish in 2024 and a slump in 2025, the Rhinos are still searching for form in NPL Season 3.

items.title: Sudurpaschim climb to third after five-wicket win over Chitwan
items.blurb: Brandon McMullen’s 43 and an unbeaten 20 from Aarif Sheikh helped the Royals chase down a target of 130 in 16.4 overs.

items.title: US overtakes India as Nepal’s largest tourism source market for first time
items.blurb: American arrivals surged 31 percent in October, while Indian visitors fell 30 percent as the August floods disrupted pilgrimage routes and dampened travel from Nepal’s traditionally biggest source market.

items.title: Sudurpaschim restrict Chitwan to 129 in NPL clash
items.blurb: Scott Kuggeleijn takes two wickets while Ravi Bopara top-scores with 49 as the Rhinos struggle to build a competitive total.

items.title: Construction boom pushes Nepal’s mountain settlements into flood-prone areas
items.blurb: A new study finds at least 108,500 people in Nepal are exposed to potential flooding, as hydropower development, road expansion and unplanned urbanisation increase risks in vulnerable mountain regions.

items.title: Indigenous climate activist Pema Wangmo Lama on flood recovery, loans and who gets to say no to hydropower
items.blurb: Lama, who recently attended the UN biodiversity talks, says post-disaster work in Nepal focuses on infrastructure rather than communities, and that safeguards for Indigenous people near hydropower projects rarely work…
